cards.title: Two-Spouted Strainer Askos (Flask) with Lid
cards.extract: Although now referred to by the Greek term askos, because of its resemblance to the animal skins used to hold wine in ancient Greece, this ceramic shape developed in the South Italian region of Daunia (north of Apulia, on the Adriatic coast). This example is unusual for its three openings—one covered by a lid, the others spouted with built-in strainers. Its profusely painted decoration, mostly geometric and vegetal patterns applied in black with added red and white, is arranged in bands that follow the contours of the vessel.

cards.title: Tesla launches flying Roadster concept car
cards.extract: Electric car company Tesla has unveiled its flying Roadster vehicle with a demonstration in which the car drove upside down, flipped off a ramp and briefly flew, using compressed-air thrusters that Tesla claims will make it the world’s quickest production car. cards.title: thessaloniki’s layered historic center weaves into expandable pedestrian network
cards.extract: linked by a neutral urban skin, apostolopoulos tasoulis’ masterplan establishes an expandable urban network designed to unify over seventy monuments and archaeological sites across thessaloniki, greece. cards.title: Renovation of the Core Area of TAFA Art Block / Mix Architecture
cards.extract: To the west of the Tianjin Academy of Fine Arts lies a century-old urban fabric.
